question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'January–June 2025' AS period, TO_DATE('2025-01-01') AS start_date, TO_DATE('2025-07-01') AS end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'July–December 2025', TO_DATE('2025-07-01'), TO_DATE('2026-01-01')
), customer_orders AS (
  SELECT p.period, o.CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM periods p
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE >= p.start_date AND o.ORDER_DATE < p.end_date
  WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.period, o.CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT p.period, COUNT_IF(COALESCE(c.order_count, 0) >= 2) AS repeat_customers
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN customer_orders c ON c.period = p.period
GROUP BY p.period
ORDER BY p.period
action.metrics: Distinct customers with at least two recorded orders in each half, counting all order records regardless of status.

action.answer: Using repeat status separately within each half (at least 2 recorded orders by the same customer in that half), and counting orders regardless of status: January–June 2025 had 95,048 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 96,514. July–December had 1,466 more repeat customers.

final_answer: Using repeat status separately within each half (at least 2 recorded orders by the same customer in that half), and counting orders regardless of status: January–June 2025 had 95,048 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 96,514. July–December had 1,466 more repeat customers.
